column1: # Callgrind executed-instruction totals, one row per measurement.
# Instrument: callgrind-3.24.0, collection toggled around the call loop only (CALLGRIND_ZERO_STATS +
# CALLGRIND_TOGGLE_COLLECT in the harness), so Ir_total is the work of n contiguous calls plus the
# harness's own loop and call control (20 instructions, the same at n=1 and n=65).
# Per-call marginal = (Ir(n=65) - Ir(n=1))/64; it is what COST_MODEL.md counts ("call and loop work").
# gt_member is the program's own blst_fp12_in_group() result printed after the loop (cyc2), 1 = still in GT.
